description: Real-site pilot call plan (pilot_rule.md + addendum 1a16fa1, pilot_analysis_plan.md + addenda 9f0bb2b, 9ead395); for the p1/batch runner, pilot profile. One generation per (target x cell); events listed in Tranco-rank, target, encoding, cell order. class_only cells whose observation is byte-identical to B_noVolatile are not called (pilot_reuse_map.json).

fields.model_env: as batch_plan.json; deployment env var (BAR_MODEL_DEPLOYMENT_1, the corpus gpt-4.1)
fields.bundle: as batch_plan.json; code bundle: B_full, B_noVolatileConsistent (pilot B_noVolatile), B_full_minus_volClass (pilot class_only)
fields.page: as batch_plan.json, here the site key <rank:04d>_<domain> (observation dump / manifest key)
fields.task_id: as batch_plan.json, here the target marker t_NN (targets.json 'marker'; unique within a site)
fields.cell: pilot cell label: B_full, B_noVolatile, class_only
fields.xpath: target XPath on the May page (targets.json; sets the data-oracle-id marker)
fields.stratum: has stable signal / no stable signal (targets.json; condition 5 on B_full)
fields.observation_sha256: sha256 of the observation text for (page, bundle, encoding), = observations_manifest.tsv
fields.input_tokens: CountTokens(SystemPrompt) + CountTokens(BuildUserPrompt(obs, task)), o200k_base (observations/prompt_tokens.tsv, as summed in cost_estimate.json)

budget.stop_rule: Track the cumulative list-price cost from the API-reported prompt and completion tokens. Stop before any call whose upper bound ((input_tokens + 16) x $2.00/M + 256 x $8.00/M) would take the total above hard_cap_usd. Calls not made because of the cap are reported as such and not replaced.
